name: Gradient Correction for Anisotropic/Sheared Data
definition: A method to correct gradients estimated from anisotropic or sheared volume data so that lighting calculations (diffuse/specular) are accurate, avoiding the computational cost of full 3D convolution.
summary: Gradient Correction for Anisotropic/Sheared Data corrects voxel-space gradients for accurate lighting by decomposing transformations into shear-scale and rotation, reducing computational cost compared to full 3D convolution.
